header: A large team as dense, scannable rows
lead: Four to two hundred people, one line each: a small avatar, the name, the role, and a link where there is one. Rows stay one line tall at desktop widths.
note: The note under the list is for the sentence about reaching people — the one thing a directory of names cannot say row by row.
